source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ORACLE_SOURCE_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'oracle_datalake_storage') AS Oracle_datalake_storage_ORACLESOURCE_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ORACLE_SOURCE_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'oracle_datalake_storage') AS Oracle_datalake_storage_ORACLESOURCE_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ORACLE_SOURCE_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'oracle_datalake_storage') AS Oracle_datalake_storage_ORACLESOURCE_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DEV_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'oracle_datalake_storage') AS Oracle_datalake_storage_DEV_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DEV_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'oracle_datalake_storage') AS Oracle_datalake_storage_DEV_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'DEV_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'oracle_datalake_storage') AS Oracle_datalake_storage_DEV_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Oracle_datalake_storage0_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import') AS Oracle_datalake_storage0_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Oracle_datalake_storage0_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_storage_ingestion_data_import') AS Oracle_datalake_storage0_sink_TableName;

FirstPart_SQL.defaultValue: SELECT *  FROM  (      SELECT DISTINCT            BAT.BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID          , BAT.DEST_LVL1_WF_GUID AS APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID          , BAT.DEST_LVL1_NAME AS APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME          , BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID AS OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_GUID          , BAT.DEST_LVL2_SYS_CLASS_NAME AS OBJECT_STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME          , BAT.DEST_LVL2_NAME AS OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_NAME          , STR.CHILD_WF_GUID AS STORAGE_CLUSTER_GUID          , STR.CHILD_NAME AS STORAGE_CLUSTER_NAME          , s.\"wf_guid\" AS STORAGE_WF_GUID          , s.\"sys_class_name\" AS STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME          , s.SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION          , s.\"name\" AS STORAGE_NAME          , s.SYS_CREATED_ON AS STORAGE_SYS_CREATED_ON          , s.SYS_UPDATED_ON AS STORAGE_SYS_UPDATED_ON          , s.OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION          , DD.DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_NAME          , DD.NAME AS DEVICE_NAME          , DD.LOCATION_NAME          , DD.DATA_CENTER_NAME          , DD.DEVICE_WF_GUID          , DD.DATA_CENTER_NEIGHBORHOOD          , DD.DATA_CENTER_ZONE          , DD.U_RPT_CPU_TOTAL_CORES          , DD.U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD          , DD.U_DC_ZONE          , DD.U_NEW_PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE          , DD.COMMON_NAME          , DD.U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME          , DD.U_DC_ZONE_NAME          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER            (                PARTITION BY                      BAT.BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID                    , BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID                    , BAT.DEST_LVL1_WF_GUID                ORDER BY BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID            ) RNO      FROM ITM_CURATED.BUSINESS_APPLICATION_TOPOLOGY BAT      JOIN ITM_CURATED.STORAGE_RLTNP STR          ON BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID = STR.PARENT_WF_GUID      JOIN ITM_CURATED.DEVICE_RLTNP DR          ON DR.CHILD_WF_GUID = STR.CHILD_WF_GUID         AND STR.CHILD_SYS_CLASS_NAME = 'CMDB_CI_STORAGE_CLUSTER'      JOIN ITM_CURATED.DEVICE_DIMENSION DD          ON DR.PARENT_WF_GUID = DD.DEVICE_WF_GUID      JOIN ITM_CURATED.STORAGE s          ON s.\"wf_guid\" = STR.PARENT_WF_GUID      WHERE BAT.DEST_LVL2_SYS_CLASS_NAME = 'U_CMDB_CI_OBJECTSTORAGE_TENANT'  ) X  WHERE RNO = 1    UNION ALL    SELECT *  FROM  (      SELECT DISTINCT            BAT.BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID          , BAT.DEST_LVL1_WF_GUID AS APPLICATION_SERVICE_GUID          , BAT.DEST_LVL1_NAME AS APPLICATION_SERVICE_NAME          , BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID AS OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_GUID          , BAT.DEST_LVL2_SYS_CLASS_NAME AS OBJECT_STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME          , BAT.DEST_LVL2_NAME AS OBJECT_STORAGE_TENANT_NAME          , STR.CHILD_WF_GUID AS STORAGE_CLUSTER_GUID          , STR.CHILD_NAME AS STORAGE_CLUSTER_NAME          , s.\"wf_guid\" AS STORAGE_WF_GUID          , s.\"sys_class_name\" AS STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_NAME          , s.SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION          , s.\"name\" AS STORAGE_NAME          , s.SYS_CREATED_ON AS STORAGE_SYS_CREATED_ON          , s.SYS_UPDATED_ON AS STORAGE_SYS_UPDATED_ON          , s.OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION AS STORAGE_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION          , DD.DEVICE_SYS_CLASS_NAME          , DD.NAME AS DEVICE_NAME          , DD.LOCATION_NAME          , DD.DATA_CENTER_NAME          , DD.DEVICE_WF_GUID          , DD.DATA_CENTER_NEIGHBORHOOD          , DD.DATA_CENTER_ZONE          , DD.U_RPT_CPU_TOTAL_CORES          , DD.U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD          , DD.U_DC_ZONE          , DD.U_NEW_PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE          , DD.COMMON_NAME          , DD.U_DC_NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME          , DD.U_DC_ZONE_NAME          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER            (                PARTITION BY                      BAT.BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID                    , BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID                    , BAT.DEST_LVL1_WF_GUID                ORDER BY BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID            ) RNO      FROM ITM_CURATED.BUSINESS_APPLICATION_TOPOLOGY BAT      JOIN ITM_CURATED.STORAGE_RLTNP STR          ON BAT.DEST_LVL2_WF_GUID = STR.PARENT_WF_GUID      JOIN ITM_CURATE

SecondPart_SQL.defaultValue: D.DEVICE_RLTNP DR          ON DR.CHILD_WF_GUID = STR.CHILD_WF_GUID         AND STR.CHILD_SYS_CLASS_NAME = 'CMDB_CI_STORAGE_SERVER'      JOIN ITM_CURATED.DEVICE_DIMENSION DD          ON DR.PARENT_WF_GUID = DD.DEVICE_WF_GUID      JOIN ITM_CURATED.STORAGE s          ON s.\"wf_guid\" = STR.PARENT_WF_GUID      WHERE BAT.DEST_LVL2_SYS_CLASS_NAME = 'CMDB_CI_STORAGE_VOLUME'  ) X  WHERE RNO = 1
